speaker_role: essay coach at consultancy (Kevin, ElevatEd School)
commercial_incentive: Sells paid essay editing and promotes a discount code and playlist.
key_insights: Read each prompt closely: similar-looking why-us prompts ask for different things, such as culture versus academics versus how prior activities continue.
Include several specific proper nouns (courses, professors, clubs); the speaker calls omission a red flag.
Digging up obscure details or contacting current students can make an essay less generic.
Explain what you personally would contribute to a club or tradition rather than merely listing it.
Two structures shown: a story-based opening about your interests, or a dense list of specific offerings; contribution can appear in other essays.
specific_numbers_or_facts: Speaker suggests at least two proper nouns per essay.
Speaker suggests roughly the first 100 words of the story-based approach center on you and your interests.
notable_or_distinctive: Contrasts Columbia, Yale and Penn prompts and shows two annotated sample essays.
reliability_notes: Coach claims about what each school wants are unsourced except a mention of the Yale admissions podcast; sales framing present.
